stage: Stage 2 acquisition contract; no real macro panel included

features.growth_revision_pp: same-target next-quarter growth forecast revision; pp annualized
features.inflation_revision_pp: same-target CPI forecast revision; pp annualized
features.borrowing_flow_pct_gdp: change in public Treasury debt / prior nominal GDP *100; percent of annualized GDP
features.fed_treasury_flow_pct_gdp: change in Fed Treasury holdings / prior nominal GDP *100; percent of annualized GDP
features.oil_log_change_pct: 100*log(current quarterly average Brent / prior quarterly average Brent)
features.unemployment_change_pp: latest available 3-month-average unemployment minus prior 3-month average; pp
features.policy_revision_pp: same-target SPF 3-month bill yield forecast revision; pp

availability: Every selected feature requires <feature_name>_available_date, at most quarter_end
provenance: Retain raw reference periods, forecast targets, component release dates and vintages separately; available_date=max(component release dates)
units: 1 percentage point = 100 basis points; yield targets in bp
